en: Colorized historic street view of a European city showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with multi‑story shopfronts and ornate façades. Hanging signs in Hungarian advertise various businesses. In the background stands a baroque church or chapel with twin green domes. The top of the front side bears printed red text identifying the location. The reverse side is blank except for printed Hungarian words indicating it is a postcard and a publisher line at the bottom.
